revision.reason: Patch 04.1: make retrieval targets explicit, repair brittle LLM query-expansion schema handling, and add a separate D-Lys-enriched chirality discovery lane while keeping final chirality comparison anchored to direct L-vs-D evidence.

background_queries.purpose: Amphiphilic polypeptide or poly(amino acid) systems relevant to antigen, vaccine or protein delivery
background_queries.query: TITLE_ABS:(polypeptide OR "poly(amino acid)" OR polyaminoacid) AND TITLE_ABS:(antigen OR vaccine OR protein OR biomacromolecule) AND TITLE_ABS:(delivery OR carrier OR nanoparticle OR adjuvant)

background_queries.purpose: Cationic/basic polypeptide functions relevant to cellular or biomacromolecule delivery
background_queries.query: TITLE_ABS:("cationic polypeptide" OR "cationic polymer" OR "basic polypeptide") AND TITLE_ABS:(uptake OR intracellular OR endosomal OR delivery OR antigen)

candidate_search_template.policy: K, R and H must use identical evidence dimensions and identical non-candidate search terms.
candidate_search_template.multi_query_policy: Generate dimension-level variants without candidate names, then render the same variants for K/R/H. Preserve the canonical query as v0; do not tune a candidate after seeing retrieval results.

candidate_queries.query: TITLE_ABS:(polylysine OR "poly-L-lysine" OR "lysine-based polypeptide" OR "lysine polypeptide") AND TITLE_ABS:(antigen OR protein OR vaccine OR biomacromolecule OR mRNA) AND TITLE_ABS:(delivery OR carrier OR uptake OR presentation)
TITLE_ABS:(polylysine OR "poly-L-lysine" OR "lysine-based polypeptide" OR "lysine polypeptide") AND TITLE_ABS:(intracellular OR uptake OR internalization OR endosomal OR endosome)
TITLE_ABS:(polylysine OR "poly-L-lysine" OR "lysine-based polypeptide" OR "lysine polypeptide") AND TITLE_ABS:(cytotoxicity OR toxicity OR biocompatibility OR hemolysis)

TITLE_ABS:(polylysine OR "poly-L-lysine" OR "lysine-based polypeptide" OR "lysine polypeptide") AND TITLE_ABS:(dendritic OR "antigen presentation" OR "cross-presentation" OR immune OR immunotherapy OR adjuvant OR vaccine)

TITLE_ABS:(polyarginine OR "poly-L-arginine" OR "arginine-based polypeptide" OR "arginine polypeptide") AND TITLE_ABS:(antigen OR protein OR vaccine OR biomacromolecule OR mRNA) AND TITLE_ABS:(delivery OR carrier OR uptake OR presentation)
TITLE_ABS:(polyarginine OR "poly-L-arginine" OR "arginine-based polypeptide" OR "arginine polypeptide") AND TITLE_ABS:(intracellular OR uptake OR internalization OR endosomal OR endosome)
TITLE_ABS:(polyarginine OR "poly-L-arginine" OR "arginine-based polypeptide" OR "arginine polypeptide") AND TITLE_ABS:(cytotoxicity OR toxicity OR biocompatibility OR hemolysis)

TITLE_ABS:(polyarginine OR "poly-L-arginine" OR "arginine-based polypeptide" OR "arginine polypeptide") AND TITLE_ABS:(dendritic OR "antigen presentation" OR "cross-presentation" OR immune OR immunotherapy OR adjuvant OR vaccine)

TITLE_ABS:(polyhistidine OR "poly-L-histidine" OR "histidine-based polypeptide" OR "histidine polypeptide") AND TITLE_ABS:(antigen OR protein OR vaccine OR biomacromolecule OR mRNA) AND TITLE_ABS:(delivery OR carrier OR uptake OR presentation)
TITLE_ABS:(polyhistidine OR "poly-L-histidine" OR "histidine-based polypeptide" OR "histidine polypeptide") AND TITLE_ABS:(intracellular OR uptake OR internalization OR endosomal OR endosome)
TITLE_ABS:(polyhistidine OR "poly-L-histidine" OR "histidine-based polypeptide" OR "histidine polypeptide") AND TITLE_ABS:(cytotoxicity OR toxicity OR biocompatibility OR hemolysis)

TITLE_ABS:(polyhistidine OR "poly-L-histidine" OR "histidine-based polypeptide" OR "histidine polypeptide") AND TITLE_ABS:(dendritic OR "antigen presentation" OR "cross-presentation" OR immune OR immunotherapy OR adjuvant OR vaccine)

lys_chirality_queries.query: TITLE_ABS:("L-lysine" OR "poly-L-lysine" OR "poly(L-lysine)") AND TITLE_ABS:(polypeptide OR polymer OR nanoparticle OR nanoadjuvant OR vaccine OR adjuvant) AND TITLE_ABS:(dendritic OR immune OR immunotherapy OR "antigen presentation" OR "cross-presentation")

TITLE_ABS:("D-lysine" OR "poly-D-lysine" OR "poly(D-lysine)") AND TITLE_ABS:(polypeptide OR polymer OR nanoparticle OR nanoadjuvant OR vaccine OR adjuvant) AND TITLE_ABS:(dendritic OR immune OR immunotherapy OR "antigen presentation" OR "cross-presentation")

lys_chirality_queries.purpose: Direct L-Lys versus D-Lys comparison in immune polypeptide/nanoadjuvant systems
lys_chirality_queries.query: TITLE_ABS:(lysine AND (chiral OR chirality OR stereochemistry OR stereochemical)) AND TITLE_ABS:(polypeptide OR polymer OR nanoparticle OR nanoadjuvant OR vaccine OR adjuvant) AND TITLE_ABS:(immune OR dendritic OR "antigen presentation" OR immunotherapy)

lys_chirality_queries.purpose: D-Lys-focused dendritic-cell, antigen-presentation and vaccine/adjuvant evidence
lys_chirality_queries.query: TITLE_ABS:("D-lysine" OR "poly-D-lysine" OR "poly(D-lysine)") AND TITLE_ABS:(polypeptide OR polymer OR nanoparticle OR nanoadjuvant) AND TITLE_ABS:(dendritic OR maturation OR "antigen presentation" OR "cross-presentation" OR adjuvant OR vaccine)

lys_chirality_queries.purpose: D-Lys-focused adaptive immune and antitumor response evidence in material systems
lys_chirality_queries.query: TITLE_ABS:("D-lysine" OR "poly-D-lysine" OR "poly(D-lysine)") AND TITLE_ABS:(polypeptide OR polymer OR nanoparticle OR nanoadjuvant) AND TITLE_ABS:("adaptive immune" OR "T cell" OR "T-cell" OR antibody OR antitumor OR immunotherapy)

lys_chirality_queries.purpose: Explicit L-Lys and D-Lys co-mentioned comparison in immune polypeptide/nanoparticle systems
lys_chirality_queries.query: TITLE_ABS:(("D-lysine" OR "poly-D-lysine" OR "poly(D-lysine)") AND ("L-lysine" OR "poly-L-lysine" OR "poly(L-lysine)")) AND TITLE_ABS:(polypeptide OR polymer OR nanoparticle OR nanoadjuvant OR vaccine OR adjuvant) AND TITLE_ABS:(immune OR dendritic OR "antigen presentation" OR "cross-presentation" OR immunotherapy)

synthetic_feasibility_queries.purpose: NCA polymerization evidence for polypeptide synthesis
synthetic_feasibility_queries.query: TITLE_ABS:("N-carboxyanhydride" OR "NCA polymerization") AND TITLE_ABS:(polypeptide OR "poly(amino acid)" OR polymerization)

screening_policy.lys_chirality_scope: Only Lys chirality is resolved after K/R/H identity selection. Arg, His and the 17 assembly-block amino acids are not subjected to D/L search in V1.

chirality_retrieval_policy.d_lys_enrichment_purpose: Increase recall for D-Lys immune-material evidence and mechanisms; enrichment alone must not be interpreted as proof that D-Lys is superior to L-Lys.
